health_wellbeing_head_injury_or_illness.text: Has %1 had a head injury or any illness affecting the brain?
health_wellbeing_head_injury_or_illness.hint:
This includes:

  • traumatic brain injury
  • acquired brain injury
  • having fits
  • significant episodes of unconsciousness as a result of a head injury
health_wellbeing_head_injury_or_illness.validation: Select if they have had a head injury or any illness affecting the brain

health_wellbeing_learning_difficulties.text: Does %1 have any conditions or disabilities that impact their ability to learn? (optional)
health_wellbeing_learning_difficulties.hint: This refers to both learning disabilities (reduced intellectual ability) and learning difficulties (such as dyslexia or ADHD).

option.YES_SIGNIFICANT_DIFFICULTIES: Yes, their ability to learn is significantly impacted
option.YES_SOME_DIFFICULTIES: Yes, their ability to learn is slightly impacted
option.NO: No, they do not have any conditions or disabilities that impact their ability to learn

option.SOME_NEGATIVE_ASPECTS: There are some aspects they would like to change or do not like

NEGATIVE.hint: This includes if they have an overly positive or unrealistic self-image which in reality is not true.
